investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (3450) was observed from Tiina.Koppel@globalcorp.ee, significantly above the 24-hour baseline of 12. The activity originated from Klaipeda, Lithuania at 03:05:22 UTC, corresponding to early morning local time, and used a Python-based user agent, suggesting automated data retrieval rather than typical human-driven activity. The downloaded samples include multiple sensitive or restricted files from the Global_Innovation_Master_Vault site. Given the user's senior role in R&D and the volume and sensitivity of the data, this appears risky and warrants escalation for investigation.
